summary: This Form 6-K contains a call notice for an Extraordinary General Meeting of Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. to fix the number of board members, elect two new members, and confirm the board composition. There are no special-situation terms such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, or restructuring. The filing is a routine governance and board-election notification filed by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, prices, or strategic transactions are present. As such, it does not qualify as a special situation under the defined categories.
